description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Fuel Filter Clamp & Attachment Bolt
This Clamp Attaches the Fuel Filter to the Frame
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Clamp
Qty 1 – Bolt
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
